body.message: Azure VM health checks are running for the requested VM. No remediation changes are performed.

body.query: @concat('Resources | where type =~ ''microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'' | extend OSHostName=tostring(properties.osProfile.computerName) | extend ShortOSHostName=tostring(split(OSHostName,''.'')[0]) | where toupper(name) == ''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),''' or toupper(OSHostName) == ''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),''' or toupper(ShortOSHostName) == ''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),''' | join kind=leftouter (ResourceContainers | where type =~ ''microsoft.resources/subscriptions'' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName=name) on subscriptionId | project Hostname=OSHostName, VMName=name, SubscriptionId=subscriptionId, SubscriptionName, ResourceGroup=resourceGroup, Location=location, ResourceId=id, VMSize=tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), OSType=tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType), ComputerName=tostring(properties.osProfile.computerName), SecurityType=tostring(properties.securityProfile.securityType), IdentityType=tostring(identity.type), BootDiagnosticsEnabled=tobool(properties.diagnosticsProfile.bootDiagnostics.enabled), Tags=tags')

inputs.uri: @concat('https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/',outputs('VM_Record')?['SubscriptionId'],'/providers/Microsoft.Insights/eventtypes/management/values?api-version=',parameters('activityLogApiVersion'),'&$filter=',uriComponent(concat('eventTimestamp ge ''',formatDateTime(addHours(utcNow(),-24),'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'),''' and eventTimestamp le ''',formatDateTime(utcNow(),'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'),''' and resourceUri eq ''',outputs('VM_Record')?['ResourceId'],'''')),'&$select=authorization,claims,correlationId,description,eventName,eventTimestamp,level,operationName,resourceGroupName,resourceId,status,submissionTimestamp,subscriptionId')

body.query: @concat('RecoveryServicesResources | where type =~ ''microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'' | extend SourceResourceId=tostring(properties.sourceResourceId) | where tolower(SourceResourceId) == tolower(''',outputs('VM_Record')?['ResourceId'],''') | project Name=name, VaultId=tostring(properties.vaultId), PolicyName=tostring(properties.policyName), ProtectionStatus=tostring(properties.protectionStatus), ProtectionState=tostring(properties.protectionState), HealthStatus=tostring(properties.healthStatus), LastBackupStatus=tostring(properties.lastBackupStatus), LastBackupTime=tostring(properties.lastBackupTime), LastRecoveryPoint=tostring(properties.lastRecoveryPoint), SourceResourceId')

@concat('Resources | where type =~ ''microsoft.compute/disks'' | where tolower(tostring(managedBy)) == tolower(''',outputs('VM_Record')?['ResourceId'],''') | project Name=name, ResourceId=id, ResourceGroup=resourceGroup, Location=location, SizeGB=toint(properties.diskSizeGB), Sku=tostring(sku.name), DiskState=tostring(properties.diskState), EncryptionType=tostring(properties.encryption.type), NetworkAccessPolicy=tostring(properties.networkAccessPolicy)')

@concat('Resources | where type =~ ''microsoft.network/networkinterfaces'' | where tolower(tostring(properties.virtualMachine.id)) == tolower(''',outputs('VM_Record')?['ResourceId'],''') | mv-expand IpConfig=properties.ipConfigurations | project Name=name, ResourceId=id, PrivateIp=tostring(IpConfig.properties.privateIPAddress), PrivateIpAllocation=tostring(IpConfig.properties.privateIPAllocationMethod), SubnetId=tostring(IpConfig.properties.subnet.id), NSGId=tostring(properties.networkSecurityGroup.id), AcceleratedNetworking=tobool(properties.enableAcceleratedNetworking), IPForwarding=tobool(properties.enableIPForwarding)')

@concat('PatchAssessmentResources | where tolower(id) == strcat(tolower(''',outputs('VM_Record')?['ResourceId'],'''), ''/patchassessmentresults/latest'') | project AssessmentId=id, AssessmentName=name, Properties=properties')

@concat('Resources | where type =~ ''microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'' | where tolower(name) == tolower(''',outputs('Select_Regional_LAW_Name'),''') | where tolower(location) == tolower(''',outputs('VM_Record')?['Location'],''') | project WorkspaceName=name, WorkspaceId=tostring(properties.customerId), WorkspaceResourceId=id, WorkspaceSubscriptionId=subscriptionId, WorkspaceResourceGroup=resourceGroup, WorkspaceLocation=location | take 2')

@concat('let RID=tolower(''',outputs('VM_Record')?['ResourceId'],'''); let H=toupper(''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),'''); Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where tolower(tostring(_ResourceId)) == RID or toupper(Computer) == H or toupper(tostring(split(Computer,''.'')[0])) == H | summarize LastHeartbeat=max(TimeGenerated), Computer=any(Computer), ResourceId=any(_ResourceId) | where isnotnull(LastHeartbeat) | project LastHeartbeat, Computer, ResourceId')

@concat('let RID=tolower(''',outputs('VM_Record')?['ResourceId'],'''); let H=toupper(''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),'''); let IMBase=InsightsMetrics | where Origin == "vm.azm.ms" | where tolower(tostring(_ResourceId)) == RID or toupper(Computer) == H or toupper(tostring(split(Computer,".")[0])) == H; let IM=IMBase | where (Namespace == "Memory" and Name == "AvailableMB") or (Namespace == "LogicalDisk" and Name in ("FreeSpacePercentage","FreeSpaceMB")) | extend Instance=tostring(todynamic(Tags)["vm.azm.ms/mountId"]) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Namespace, Name, Instance | extend Value=todouble(Val), Tags=tostring(Tags), Source="InsightsMetrics", Priority=2.0 | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Namespace, Name, Instance, Value, Tags, Source, Priority; let IMMemoryPct=IMBase | where Namespace == "Memory" and Name == "AvailableMB" | extend TotalMemoryMB=todouble(todynamic(Tags)["vm.azm.ms/memorySizeMB"]) | where TotalMemoryMB > 0 | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer | extend Namespace="Memory", Name="AvailablePercent", Instance="", Value=100.0*todouble(Val)/TotalMemoryMB, Tags=tostring(Tags), Source="InsightsMetrics", Priority=2.0 | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Namespace, Name, Instance, Value, Tags, Source, Priority; let PMemory=Perf | where tolower(tostring(_ResourceId)) == RID or toupper(Computer) == H or toupper(tostring(split(Computer,''.'')[0])) == H | where ObjectName == "Memory" | where CounterName in ("Available MBytes","Available MBytes Memory","% Committed Bytes In Use") | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, CounterName | extend Namespace="Memory", Name=case(CounterName in ("Available MBytes","Available MBytes Memory"),"AvailableMB",CounterName == "% Committed Bytes In Use","AvailablePercent",""), Instance="", Value=case(CounterName == "% Committed Bytes In Use",100.0-todouble(CounterValue),todouble(CounterValue)), Tags="{}", Source="Perf", Priority=1.0 | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Namespace, Name, Instance, Value, Tags, Source, Priority; let PDisk=Perf | where tolower(tostring(_ResourceId)) == RID or toupper(Computer) == H or toupper(tostring(split(Computer,''.'')[0])) == H | where ObjectName in ("LogicalDisk","Logical Disk") | where CounterName in ("% Free Space","Free Megabytes") | where InstanceName != "_Total" | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, InstanceName, CounterName | extend Namespace="LogicalDisk", Name=iff(CounterName == "% Free Space","FreeSpacePercentage","FreeSpaceMB"), Instance=tostring(InstanceName), Value=todouble(CounterValue), Tags="{}", Source="Perf", Priority=1.0 | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Namespace, Name, Instance, Value, Tags, Source, Priority; union IM, IMMemoryPct, PMemory, PDisk | extend Preference=Priority*1000000000000000.0 + todouble(datetime_diff(''millisecond'',TimeGenerated,datetime(1970-01-01))) | summarize arg_max(Preference, *) by Namespace, Name, Instance | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Namespace, Name, Instance, Value, Tags, Source | order by Namespace asc, Name asc, Instance asc')

@concat('let RID=tolower(''',outputs('VM_Record')?['ResourceId'],'''); let H=toupper(''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),'''); Perf | where tolower(tostring(_ResourceId)) == RID or toupper(Computer) == H or toupper(tostring(split(Computer,''.'')[0])) == H | where CounterName in ("% Processor Time","Available MBytes","Available MBytes Memory","% Committed Bytes In Use","% Free Space","Free Megabytes","Disk Reads/sec","Disk Writes/sec","Bytes Received/sec","Bytes Sent/sec") | summarize Average=avg(CounterValue), Maximum=max(CounterValue), LatestTime=max(TimeGenerated) by ObjectName, CounterName, InstanceName | project LatestTime, ObjectName, CounterName, InstanceName, Average, Maximum')

@concat('Resources | where type =~ ''microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'' | where tolower(name) == tolower(''',parameters('westEuropeFallbackLawName'),''') | project WorkspaceName=name, WorkspaceId=tostring(properties.customerId), WorkspaceResourceId=id, WorkspaceSubscriptionId=subscriptionId, WorkspaceResourceGroup=resourceGroup, WorkspaceLocation=location | take 2')
